Initialize a UNO Game Session

setup_game.Rd

Sets up a playable UNO game state by generating a complete deck, shuffling it, dealing 7 cards to each player, drawing the first discard card, and initializing gameplay direction and player turn order.

Usage

setup_game(n_players = 4)

Arguments

n_players

Integer. Number of players to initialize. Default is 4.
This version supports any value ≥ 2 (limited by card count).
Note: Future versions aim to support extended player formats with rule adaptations and multi-deck configurations.

Value

A named list containing:

  • hands – Named list of tibbles, one per player, each with 7 cards

  • deck – Remaining deck (after hands and discard) used as the draw pile

  • discard – One-row tibble showing the top discard card

  • direction – Integer. Initial play direction. 1 = clockwise, -1 = counter-clockwise

  • turn – Integer. Starting player's index (1-based)

Details

This is typically the first step before calling play_turns_loop or play_game to simulate gameplay.

- The function shuffles a standard 108-card deck via create_uno_deck
- Cards are dealt using deal_hands, one per player for 7 rounds
- One card is drawn to start the discard pile
- Turn direction is set to clockwise (1); turn index starts from Player 1

Examples

# Create initial game state for 4 players
game_state <- setup_game(n_players = 4)
#> Error in expand_grid(color = colors, value = as.character(numbers)) %>%     mutate(type = "number") %>% group_by(value) %>% mutate(replication = if_else(value ==     "0", 1, 2)) %>% ungroup() %>% slice(rep(1:n(), replication)) %>%     select(-replication): could not find function "%>%"

# View the structure of output
names(game_state)
#> Error: object 'game_state' not found

# Access Player 1’s hand
game_state$hands$Player_1
#> Error: object 'game_state' not found

# View initial discard card
game_state$discard
#> Error: object 'game_state' not found
